title: 101 Ways to Die in a Hostel
subtitle: Haunted Mirror
series: 101 Ways to Die in a Hostel
tagline: Some hostels are a bargain. Others cost you your life.

synopsis.short: A vain beauty influencer discovers an antique mirror in her hostel room that shows an increasingly malevolent reflection, until the reflection reaches through and pulls her into the mirror world where she suffocates in the cold void behind the glass.
